## Goal

Compute whether the configured scope can fit the configured limit and report an explicit, actionable refusal instead of looping: today an over-large scope silently re-stages and force-evicts forever. Review the default limit against the object model.

## Deliverables

- Capacity guard with an explicit user-visible reason
- Default limit decision with its measurement
